status: provisional, frozen before any empirical fit; not calibrated on real papers
basis: instructions/scoring.md; constants chosen by the coordinator for this study with stated reasons; no constants inherited from an earlier exercise

focal_estimands.published_claim: positive linear and negative squared interaction, significant
positive linear and negative squared interaction, significant
positive linear and negative squared interaction, significant

scored_scope.sign_and_direction_source: Exact per-term published values come from sealed targets; directions above restate the claim, not values.
scored_scope.not_scored: nuisance controls, descriptive figures, per-country regressions, variance-decomposition diagnostics, not-shown footnote robustness checks; their published values stay sealed and are reported as out of scored scope

implementation_agreement.compare_first: sample_hash, n_obs, n_countries, n_surveys, then origin estimates and SEs, before any target is read
implementation_agreement.estimate_tolerance: |b_i - b_j| <= 0.05 x max(se_i, se_j) or <= 0.001 absolute
implementation_agreement.pairing: two agreeing of three permit scoring on that pair; the third goes to code audit; no agreeing pair gives indeterminate:implementation_disagreement
implementation_agreement.reason: A (R lme4), B (R lme4) and C (Julia MixedModels) all use the Laplace approximation, so differences beyond optimizer tolerance indicate implementation differences

n_rule.regime: same survey source (supplied GEM harmonized file, later vintage than the article's unnamed release) with different-vintage country-level inputs
n_rule.mismatch: > 0.15: sample not reconstructed; magnitude criterion for that model is reported but its outcome cannot be consistent (indeterminate:incomplete_coverage or source_vintage)
n_rule.evaluated_by: code, using the sealed N branch

rounding: Published values are intervals [v - h, v + h], h = half a unit of the last printed digit. Distances are measured from the reconstructed estimate to the nearest interval end (0 if inside). Published SE uses its printed value; if the printed SE is zero or negative, the magnitude criterion is not audited for that cell.

magnitude.regime_applied: different_vintage for every focal and robustness estimand, because every model contains reconstructed country-level variables
magnitude.reason: Sampling noise alone gives about 1 SE; reconstructed covariates of a later vintage widen the band. Provisional.

sign.mismatch: reconstructed sign opposite to the published sign and reconstructed |z| >= 1.645
sign.published_zero: published value whose rounding interval contains 0 has no sign to compare

inference.published_band_from_stars: three bullets: p <= .01; two: .01 < p <= .05; one: .05 < p <= .10; none: p > .10 (no exact p); legend uses <=, band edges are treated as the printed inequality
inference.tail: two-tailed (both readers found the tail unstated)
inference.alpha: the paper's lowest legend level .10 for a marked result; .05 for statements of significance in the text
inference.outside: a change of two or more bands; for a published significant claim, weaker by two or more bands; for a published nonsignificant claim, reconstructed p < .01
inference.stronger_significance: stronger supported significance in the published direction is not a failure

benchmark_inference.adaptation_declared_before_execution: Model class is a multilevel logit or linear mixed model with country-level predictors. Benchmark: same fixed terms in a pooled logit (or OLS for M5) with country-clustered CR1 sandwich SEs (assignment unit: country). M5 additionally uses a restricted wild cluster bootstrap with Rademacher weights because G = 24 is below the threshold.
benchmark_inference.fragile_inference_rule: magnitude and sign within tolerance at the origin, native band consistent, and the benchmark band weaker by two or more bands for a published significant claim
benchmark_inference.limitation: the pooled benchmark removes the random effects, so it is an adaptation, not the same estimator

specification_sets.equivalent_set: empty after reconciliation; specification fragility is not assessed
specification_sets.uncertain_set: U01-U26 one-at-a-time deviations; reported separately as sign share, share significant in the published direction at .05 (two-tailed), median, min-max, and the published estimate's position; not used to change an outcome
specification_sets.influence: leave-one-country-out ranges reported as influence ranges, not confidence intervals; not part of any specification set

claim_outcome.per_term: consistent if implementations agree, sign not mismatched, magnitude within, inference consistent; discrepant_candidate if implementations agree and sign mismatch, or magnitude outside, or inference outside; indeterminate if any criterion is grey and no criterion is outside, or if N is a mismatch, or if implementations disagree
claim_outcome.per_estimand_group: all terms consistent -> consistent; any term discrepant_candidate -> discrepant_candidate; otherwise indeterminate with the sub-code of the first non-consistent term
claim_outcome.discrepant_final: a discrepant_candidate becomes discrepant only after adversarial review by a model family independent of the implementers and actual human confirmation; until then it is reported as discrepant_candidate (unconfirmed)
claim_outcome.grey_zone: benefit of uncertainty goes to indeterminate

paper_aggregation.focal_structure: Three hypothesis groups: H1 (F01-F03), H2 (F05-F07), H3 (F08-F12); F04 is the baseline gender gap. The article's supported focal results are F02, F05, F06, F08, F09, F10 and F11.
paper_aggregation.rule: Hypothesis outcome = outcome of its supported focal estimands under the claim precedence (H1: F02; H2: F05 and F06; H3: F08-F11); its nonsignificant focal estimands qualify the description. Paper outcome: any not_attemptable or indeterminate supported focal hypothesis -> paper indeterminate; else any discrepant (confirmed) -> not reproduced; else all consistent and no tier discrepant -> fully reproduced; all focal consistent but lower-tier discrepant -> partially reproduced. discrepant_candidate without human confirmation makes the paper indeterminate:awaiting_confirmation.
paper_aggregation.reason: follows instructions/scoring.md mapping; avoids a worst-cell rule by naming the supported focal estimands in advance

missingness_failure: Failed or non-converged origin fits make that estimand indeterminate:implementation_failure. Failed deviation and influence fits are retained and counted, never dropped.

compute_budget.implementations: A and B: ORIGIN; A and C: ORIGIN, all deviations and influence. B runs deviations only if time remains after A and C finish.
compute_budget.order: ORIGIN, deviations in listed order, N01, influence

calibration_status: No planted-error, null-data or post-cutoff calibration arms were run in this session; synthetic rule tests run on fabricated inputs only. Constants are provisional.
